title: Shared board step 2: card changes become pull requests (or issues) opened as the person who made them
notes: Design: board spec, section Shared mode. Branch plus pull request that patches the task file, opened with the user's GitHub App user token so GitHub enforces rights; never push to a default branch; reuse the file-hash check.

The local board already changes items (tadu board --allow write, POST /api/op/<name> running the command); shared mode should route the same calls into a branch and pull request instead of writing the checkout.
result: Team board writes become a branch and pull request (or an issue for people without push) opened with the person's token; the server checkout is no longer written. Checked against the fake GitHub only.
evidence: uv run pytest: 2273 passed; tests/test_team_board_proposals.py proves one commit on a new branch plus a PR, checkout unchanged, issue for a non-writer, 409 on base mismatch, no write to the default ref, preview never reaches GitHub; ruff, ruff format, mypy clean; codeality-py check still the same 5 findings as before; tadu doctor exit 0
